context: Small mechanical PR after the ADR lands (ledger semantics needed for the data_only ruling). For each constant: define in core, import at every current literal site, add a parity test asserting the CLI click.Choice values, MCP schema enum values, and the core constant are equal (modulo the ledgered data_only decision). MCP phases validation rejects unknown phases with a validation error listing VALID_PHASES.
description: Untested constant drift found in review: run modes are {sql,dataframe} in CLI (benchbox/cli/commands/run.py:2941 click.Choice) but {sql,dataframe,data_only} in MCP (benchbox/mcp/schemas.py:736 MODE_CHOICES); the 7-item valid-phases list is duplicated twice inside CLI (run.py:840 and benchbox/cli/benchmarks.py:922) and absent from MCP validation entirely; export formats {json,csv,html} are literal in cli/commands/export.py:25 and duplicated twice with different lengths inside mcp/tools/results.py:91,99. Create canonical core constants (e.g. core/constants.py or core/schemas.py): RUN_MODES, VALID_PHASES, EXPORT_FORMATS. Both surfaces consume them; MCP gains phase validation against VALID_PHASES; the data_only asymmetry is resolved deliberately -- either exposed on both surfaces or entered in the tiered omission ledger (governance from one-engine-adr-scoped-surfaces). Replicate the chart-registry parity-test pattern (tests/unit/visualization/test_chart_type_registry.py) for each constant set.

anti_patterns.dont: resolve the data_only asymmetry by quietly removing it from MCP
anti_patterns.instead: make the deliberate ruling under the three-tier ledger and implement that
anti_patterns.why: MCP callers use data_only today; removal is a breaking surface change needing governance

anti_patterns.dont: write parity tests that grep source files for literals
anti_patterns.instead: import both surfaces' live enum/choice objects and compare sets
anti_patterns.why: behavior-driving assertions survive refactors; source greps rot

preserves.behavior: Existing accepted values keep working on both surfaces; this item may only ADD validation (MCP phases) or reconcile enums, never silently drop an accepted value.
MCP docs param tables stay schema-derived (docs drift tests keep passing).
data_only aliasing in MCP (datagen/generate -> data_only at benchmark.py:129-162) keeps accepting the aliases it accepts today.

prior_art.concept: Existing core constants module imported by cli/execution_pipeline.py
The proven cross-surface constant parity test pattern

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit -k 'constant and parity or (mode and parity) or (phase and parity)' -q
verifications.description: Mode/phase/format parity tests exist and pass
verifications.expected: CLI choices, MCP enums, and core constants are asserted equal.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/mcp -k 'phase and (invalid or unknown or reject)' -q
verifications.expected: run_benchmark with a bogus phase returns a validation error listing valid phases.

verifications.command: test "$(grep -rl 'throughput.*maintenance' benchbox/cli/commands/run.py benchbox/cli/benchmarks.py | wc -l)" -le 1 || ! grep -q 'VALID_PHASES = ' benchbox/cli/benchmarks.py
verifications.description: No duplicated phase list remains in CLI
verifications.expected: The 7-phase list is defined once, in core.

work_units.evidence: Enumerated every literal: --mode Choice (run.py:2941) vs MODE_CHOICES (schemas.py:734); the 7-phase list at run.py:840 and benchmarks.py:922; export formats at export.py:25 and results.py:91,99 (two different lengths). Traced data_only through _derive_execution_type -> ExecutionPipeline._execute_data_only, establishing it is an execution type, not a run mode.
work_units.summary: Re-verify the drift sites at HEAD; enumerate every literal occurrence of modes/phases/formats

work_units.evidence: core/constants.py gains RUN_MODES, VALID_PHASES, QUERY_PHASES, EXECUTION_TYPES, EXPORT_FORMATS, MCP_RESULT_FORMATS, MCP_MODE_CHOICES, MCP_DATA_ONLY_ALIASES; all sites migrated. validate_phases added and wired into BOTH MCP admission paths (run_benchmark and start_benchmark, the latter needing a scope amendment).
work_units.summary: Core constants + migrate all sites + MCP phase validation

work_units.evidence: Parity tests read live Click Choice objects and MCP enums, not source greps. data_only ruled an execution type rather than a run mode, with the reasoning and the inverse-ledger observation documented in docs/reference/mcp.md. No accepted value dropped. PR #1555.
work_units.summary: Parity tests per constant set; data_only ruling implemented per ledger
